name: llama.cpp src/llama-quant.cpp (llama_ftype to tensor-type mapping and per-tensor promotion rules)
notes: Authoritative source for WHICH llama_ftype name maps to WHICH GGML_TYPE, i.e. the mixture/promotion rules. Establishes that IQ2_M is not a block type (maps to GGML_TYPE_IQ2_S), IQ3_M and IQ3_XS both map to GGML_TYPE_IQ3_S, and that token-embedding / output tensors get promoted (Q5_K or Q6_K or Q2_K depending on ftype). Also confirms MXFP4_MOE is a real, current ftype not covered by any existing record. Accessed 2026-10-04.
